audio.strategy: One AudioContext. Piano notes are AudioBufferSourceNodes playing either recorded, bundled Ogg Vorbis one-shots (Grand, Upright, Electric, Clav, Digital, Misc models — decoded at runtime with @wasm-audio-decoders/ogg-vorbis) or generated buffers (the Additive Piano model and the fallback voice, rendered by src/audio/pianoRenderer.ts). Each voice feeds a per-voice GainNode → per-layer bus GainNode → LayerChain AudioWorkletNode (Timbre EQ, String Res, Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp Sim/EQ, Compressor, Reverb — pure TypeScript DSP in src/dsp/) → layer level GainNode → optionally the shared Rotary AudioWorkletNode (To Rotary) → master GainNode (Master Level) → master limiter AudioWorkletNode → destination. If AudioWorklet is unavailable the same DSP classes run in a ScriptProcessorNode. Recorded samples, generated buffers and the live fallback oscillator are always labelled as what they are.
graph: voice: AudioBufferSourceNode (+2 detuned copies through StereoPannerNode + GainNode for Unison) → voice GainNode
layer: bus GainNode → LayerChain processor (timbre → stringRes → mod1 → mod2 → delay → ampEq → compressor → reverb) → level GainNode
routing: level → master GainNode, or level → shared Rotary processor → master GainNode when the layer's Amp Sim/EQ model is To Rotary
master: master GainNode (Master Level knob, 15 ms ramps) → MasterUnit processor (limiter, threshold 0.95) → AudioContext.destination

sampleSources.name: Grand · Salamander C5
sampleSources.source: Salamander Grand Piano V3 — Alexander Holm — https://freepats.zenvoid.org/Piano/acoustic-grand-piano.html
sampleSources.recording: two AKG C414 in AB ~12 cm above the strings, 48 kHz/24-bit, 16 velocity layers, sampled in minor thirds from A0
sampleSources.processing: mono downmix, onset trim (0.2 % of peak, 1 ms fade-in), tail cut 60 dB below the peak (never below -72 dBFS) or at the per-root cap (7 / 5 / 3.5 s) with a 0.4 s raised-cosine fade, set gain -2.4 dB, Ogg Vorbis q3 at 44100 Hz
notes: Four of the sixteen recorded velocity layers are bundled (v3, v7, v11, v15); release, pedal and string-resonance samples are not.

generatedSources.name: Additive Piano (Digital model "digital-additive") and the labelled fallback voice
generatedSources.description: Up to 28 inharmonic partials with a hammer-position comb filter, velocity-dependent brightness, two-stage exponential decay, a 2 ms attack ramp and a 9 ms seeded-noise thump, rendered lazily per note and velocity layer into Float32 AudioBuffers (LRU cache of 64). Generated by code at runtime; it is not a recording. It is selectable as the second Digital model and is the playable fallback whenever a recorded set fails to load (status: fallback, "Piano not found").
generatedSources.license: Original code written for this candidate; no third-party audio material.

generatedSources.name: Fallback triangle tone
generatedSources.description: Only used when the generated renderer itself throws: a triangle OscillatorNode with a 5 ms attack and 2.5 s exponential decay through the same voice, layer and master path. Labelled "fallback oscillator" in the status strip and Program display.
generatedSources.license: Original code written for this candidate.

generatedSources.name: Effect processing (Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp Sim/EQ, Compressor, Reverb, Rotary, Timbre, String Res, master limiter)
generatedSources.generator: src/dsp/*.ts hosted by src/dsp/worklet.ts (AudioWorklet) or src/audio/browserProcessor.ts (ScriptProcessor fallback)
generatedSources.description: Algorithmic DSP written for this candidate: LFO / envelope modulators, modulated delay lines, all-pass phasers, a feedback delay with in-loop filters, RBJ biquad EQ with documented amp / cabinet approximations (Twin, JC, Small) and 24 dB resonant filters, a feed-forward compressor, comb/all-pass reverbs (Room, Booth, Stage, Hall, Cathedral) plus a dispersive spring model, a horn + bass-rotor rotary with smooth acceleration, sympathetic-string comb resonators and a peak limiter. No impulse responses or recordings are used; the same classes render offline in the tests.

decoder.name: @wasm-audio-decoders/ogg-vorbis 0.1.20
decoder.use: Decodes the bundled Ogg Vorbis samples in the browser (Web Worker) and in the Node test-suite; decoding is serialised on one instance.

notes: Web Audio is created lazily on the first key press or the Start audio button; the sample library starts loading on page load (no audio context needed) and the status strip / Program display report loading progress, ready, error (no AudioContext), and fallback (a set failed to load: the generated Additive Piano plays, labelled fallback, and the type LED flashes).
Sustain (UI pedal button, Shift key, MIDI CC64) is honoured only while SUSTPED is on (Shift + Layer A toggles it). PSTICK (Shift + Layer B) lets the pitch stick bend the Piano section ±2 semitones.

Polyphony is capped at 32 voices across both layers; the oldest sounding voice is stolen deterministically with a 20 ms release. Release is a 300 ms exponential ramp (550 ms with Soft Release; unchanged for Clav-type models), retriggered notes release in 30 ms, all-notes-off in 80 ms.

Tests never touch real audio output, MIDI devices or the network: the audio context, DSP host, asset fetching, MIDI access and timers are injected (src/audio/boundaries.ts) and faked in tests (src/audio/fakeAudio.ts); rendered-audio relationships are proved on the real bundled files decoded from disk and on the real src/dsp classes (src/audio/offlinePiano.ts, src/dsp/offline.ts).

Group mode copies the focused Piano layer's chain to both layers; Global mode (Delay, Compressor, Reverb) shares one setting and on-state across every chain; the Organ and Synth chains are stored so their focus edits go somewhere honest, but they process no audio until Phase 3.

functional: piano.on, piano.layer-a.on, piano.layer-b.on (Shift: SUSTPED / PSTICK), piano.layer-a.level, piano.layer-b.level, piano.octave-down/up, piano.type, piano.model, piano.timbre, piano.acoustics (Soft Release / String Res), piano.kb-touch, piano.unison, piano.dyn-comp

effects.on, effects.focus.organ/piano/synth (Shift + piano: Group), effects.shift, effects.mod1.*, effects.mod2.*, effects.delay.tempo/feedback/dry-wet/filter (Shift: Ping Pong)/tap/on (Shift: Global), effects.amp.* (model incl. To Rotary, LP24, HP24), effects.comp.amount (Shift: Fast)/on (Shift: Global), effects.reverb.type/tone/dry-wet/on (Shift: Global)
performance.master-level, performance.rotary.speed, performance.rotary.drive, performance.pitch-stick (only when PSTICK is on), program.shift (same Shift latch as effects.shift)
controls.decorative: Every Organ, Synth and Program control (except program.shift), performance.mod-wheel, performance.rotary.organ, performance.rotary.stop-mode, effects.delay.effect: they move or press and change presentation state only.
controls.shiftLatch: Pressing SHIFT (effects or program) arms a latch for the next panel press (8 s), so Shift functions are reachable with a single pointer or from the keyboard; holding SHIFT while pressing another button also works with touch.

unsupported: Soft pedal (una corda) and sostenuto: not claimed, not simulated (piano spec optional; the only pedal is sustain).
Pedal noise and half-pedalling (piano spec excluded): the PED NOISE LED stays off.
Nord Triple Pedal modelling and pedal-type configuration (excluded).
Piano size classes (Sml/Med/Lrg/XL), the INFO view (Shift + Piano Select) and the LIST view, Nord Sound Manager downloads (excluded).
Piano preset library, programs, Live Mode, splits, KB zones (Shift + Octave), scenes, morphs, master clock sync (MST CLK LEDs stay off) — Phase 3 or cut benchmark-wide.
Per-type effect Variations and Reverb Chorale (Shift + selector does not cycle the selector; nothing else happens).
Delay feedback-loop effects (Chor/Vibe/Ens/Flam/Space selector is decorative) and Analog mode (Shift + Tap).
Mod 1 Pump / Wah pedal modes; rotary close mic, stop mode and stop angle; the Organ rotary routing button (the organ is silent until Phase 3).
Global reverb placement after the rotary (excluded): reverb always precedes the rotary.
Organ and Synth effect chains process no audio until Phase 3 (their focus and edits are stored, inaudible and labelled).
Aftertouch, arpeggiator, Extern / Aux KB / MIDI menus (cut benchmark-wide).

inputs.pointer: pointerdown/up/cancel with per-pointer tracking, glissando across keys, independent multi-touch, velocity from the strike position on the key
inputs.computerKeyboard: physical key codes A W S E D F T G Y H U J K O L P ; ' = C4..F5 (base shifts with Z/X, clamped to the keybed), Shift = sustain, auto-repeat suppressed, blur/visibility-hidden releases everything
inputs.midi: Web MIDI note on/off with velocity on any channel, CC64 sustain, CC120/123 all notes off; unsupported / requesting / ready / denied / error / disconnected states, disconnect releases the device's notes
